facts.fact: The document is the 112-article Projecto de Lei das Transacções Electrónicas de 2025 (bill number and publication date left blank, masthead dated 6 September 2025), which would give data messages, electronic records, contracts and electronic signatures legal effect, license trust-service providers and set e-commerce consumer rules, and which enters into force only on a date the Minister designates; ARN put this revised text to public consultation, dated here by the document's published date 2026-05-08.
